result.pairwise_reason: PP014-B provides the most comprehensive per-hop evidence with three distinct dysbiosis-SCFA models (FMT/cerebral, diet-induced, antibiotic), detailed osteoclast and Treg-Wnt10b mechanisms, and an explicit caveat about missing human interventional data, making it the most rigorous and research-valuable response.
